summary: Rare's Conker series, from the family-friendly Game Boy Color debut through Bad Fur Day, its Xbox remake, Project Spark episode, and HoloLens mixed-reality spin-off.

entries.title: Conker's Pocket Tales

emulation.notes: Use GBC mode for primary play and GB mode only for comparison.

primary.why: Pocket Tales is a Game Boy Color title with some differences when run on original monochrome Game Boy hardware; GBC mode through mGBA is the best complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Game Boy Color version through mGBA or on GBC/GBA hardware.

secondary.exclusive_content: Different layout/some event differences when using the dual-format cartridge on monochrome Game Boy.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the Game Boy mode only if comparing version differences.
secondary.why: Layouts/events differ depending on whether the cartridge is played on Game Boy or Game Boy Color.

all_releases.fidelity: Original GBC release with full color presentation and flexible saving.
Dual-format cartridge runs with gameplay/layout differences on original Game Boy.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Game Boy Color is the main route, while original Game Boy mode has documented differences worth sampling only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern official port documented as of June 18, 2026; a Super Pocket Rare Edition rerelease was announced for later in June 2026.

entries.title: Conker's Bad Fur Day

emulation.emulator: Rare Replay / Xbox emulation; N64 emulator fallback
emulation.notes: Use Rare Replay for official access.

primary.why: Rare Replay includes the original N64 Conker's Bad Fur Day rather than the Xbox remake, preserving the original script and multiplayer while providing modern Xbox access.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Rare Replay on Xbox One/Series hardware; use N64 emulation only for original-cartridge comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: Rare Replay provides official modern access to the original version.

all_releases.fidelity: Rare Replay emulated release of the original N64 game.
all_releases.reason: primary: best official access route for the uncensored original-version preservation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Live & Reloaded has higher-fidelity remake visuals, but the original/Rare Replay route preserves uncensored dialogue and original multiplayer design.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate with Live & Reloaded, which is a separate remake with changes.

entries.title: Conker: Live & Reloaded

emulation.notes: Use modern Xbox hardware where possible.

primary.why: Live & Reloaded is the Xbox remake with overhauled graphics and a new Xbox Live multiplayer mode; backward compatibility is the best current route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox release on Xbox One/Series backward compatibility or original Xbox hardware.

all_releases.reason: skip: modern Xbox backward compatibility is the current route for the same release.
primary: best current route for the remake.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Higher visual fidelity than Bad Fur Day but with different multiplayer and some censored dialogue, so it is a separate remake route rather than the definitive original.

entries.remaster_caveats: Remake changes multiplayer and censors some dialogue compared with the N64 original.

entries.title: Conker's Big Reunion

emulation.notes: Depends on preserved Project Spark installation/content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox One/Windows Project Spark environment

primary.why: Big Reunion was an episodic Project Spark campaign set after Bad Fur Day; only the first episode released before remaining episodes were canceled and Project Spark was delisted.
primary.how_to_play: No current official download route is documented; play only if you already preserved Project Spark content before delisting.

all_releases.fidelity: Project Spark episodic campaign; only episode one released.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented route, now delisted/archival.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only the first episode released; remaining episodes were canceled and Project Spark is no longer available to download.

entries.remaster_caveats: Delisted Project Spark content, not a standalone packaged game.

primary.why: Young Conker is a HoloLens mixed-reality platform game that uses the player's physical surroundings, so original HoloLens hardware is required for the intended experience.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Microsoft HoloLens hardware if available; no conventional console/PC port is documented.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original HoloLens hardware/environment is part of the game design.
